name: 現在地と保存住所と履歴で選ぶ位置指定
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One Lighthouse component LH01-0091 現在地と保存住所と履歴で選ぶ位置指定. Input1 original controls glyph anatomy, saved/unset states and four history rows; input2 reused original search bar; input3 original saved shortcuts; input4 Japanese mock supplies copy and compact composition, secondary to original visible states.
Pure white#FFFFFF. Top white outlined search pill, original back chevron and small source microphone (solid capsule, U pickup, short stem, no foot), placeholder "地域や施設を検索", Meiryo Regular40014/24 gray.
Two actions below: "現在地を使用" with original SOLID northeast location dart, no outlined paperplane or inner white line; "地図上で選択" with original SOLID teardrop map pin and white center hole, not double-outline pin. Keep source sizes/positions; no added icon-circle backgrounds.
Horizontal saved shortcuts: source house icon + "自宅" / "登録済みの住所"; source rectangular briefcase with top handle + "職場" / "未設定"; source THREE HORIZONTAL DOTS + "その他" / "一覧を見る". Home is populated in original, do not use mock's empty-state住所を登録. No invented specific street address. Preserve Work unset. More is ellipsis, NOT plus. Icons inside white fine-neutral-outlined circles, coherent slate#526173; no mint backgrounds.
Below divider, context label "今日" Regular12/16. Exactly FOUR recent rows, source clock circles and fine inset dividers:
"代々木公園" / "東京都渋谷区";
"地域の図書館" / "東京都渋谷区";
"交流スペース" / "東京都新宿区";
"宿泊施設" with no subtitle.
Bottom existing text link "検索履歴をもっと見る", forestgreen#1F6444 Regular14/24, no filled button.
All titles/actions/placeholders/links Meiryo REGULAR40014/24, all helpers/section label Regular12/16, tracking0. NO bold/semibold. Coherent slate utility glyphs, white surfaces/neutral borders, quiet compact spacing. Keep full Japanese copy readable without clipping. No contacts block outside assigned source crop, new rows, photos, keyboard, device frame, enclosing card or invented state. Flat frontal raster candidate; current-location permissions, saved-address selection, search/history/mic and runtime unverified.
reviewNotes: Restored solid location dart/pin, Home populated/Work unset/More ellipsis, four Japanese history rows and Regular link. Utility palette remains mixed bright blue and black instead of coherent slate. Requires icon-only recolor; source glyph geometry/content/state reviewed separately. Raster candidate only.
